description: Implementation of the FrameParts class for testing HTTP/2 frame parsing, including methods for handling various frame types and verification utilities.

classes.name: FrameParts
classes.description: A class representing parts of an HTTP/2 frame used for testing frame parsing and validation.

methods.name: VerifyEquals
methods.description: Compares two FrameParts objects for equality.

methods.name: SetTotalPadLength
methods.description: Sets the total padding length for the frame.

methods.name: SetAltSvcExpected
methods.description: Sets expected ALTSVC origin and value data.

methods.name: OnDataPayload
methods.description: Handles payload data of DATA frame.

methods.name: OnHeadersPriority
methods.description: Handles priority information in HEADERS frame.

methods.name: OnPadLength
methods.description: Handles padding length in padded frames.

methods.name: OnSetting
methods.description: Handles individual setting in SETTINGS frame.

methods.name: OnGoAwayOpaqueData
methods.description: Handles opaque data in GOAWAY frame.

methods.name: OnUnknownStart
methods.description: Handles start of unknown frame type.

methods.name: OnPaddingTooLong
methods.description: Handles case where padding is too long.

methods.name: OutputTo
methods.description: Outputs the FrameParts details to a stream.

methods.name: StartFrameOfType
methods.description: Verifies and starts processing a frame of a specific type.

methods.name: InFrameOfType
methods.description: Checks if currently in a frame of a specific type.

methods.name: EndFrameOfType
methods.description: Ends processing of a frame of a specific type.

methods.name: InPaddedFrame
methods.description: Checks if current frame is padded.

methods.name: AppendString
methods.description: Appends a string view to a target string and verifies length constraints.
